errors.evidence: Please help me with the following research task: I need to locate and inspect the book identified by the DOI 10.2307/j.ctv9b2xdv. Specifically, please find the endnote that appears in the second-to-last paragraph on page 11 of the book. Within that endnote, there is a reference to a Wikipedia article that includes an access date in November. I need the day of the month (as a number) in November when the Wikipedia article was accessed. Could you please locate and return just that day? Provide all necessary details or a direct extraction of that number.
errors.description: The agent failed to perform the task and instead provided a task description to the final_answer tool.
